submission.natural_language_explanation: L4/H7 is an induction (in-context copy) head: at a token that already occurred earlier in the text it gives essentially all of its attention (weight 0.95-1.0) to the token that followed the most recent earlier copy and writes that token's identity into the residual stream (attention-pattern scores: previous token 0.05, duplicate 0.02, induction 0.33; at the second 'Footage' it copies ' Lets', at the second ' (' it copies ' Ph' of Phonographic, at the second ' ||' it copies the team name ' Rem', at the second 'ischer' it copies ' Ent'). Its strength is the distance of that copied token from its mean write, so it peaks (1.7-2.2 of the 2.197 maximum) exactly when the copied continuation is a rare, information-rich piece - a fragment of a name or technical term (' Rem', ' Min', ' Altern', ' Ent', ' Ph', ' Riv'), a numeral such as ' 1', or a markup/code symbol ('{%', ' ||', '("'); it is 1.0-1.7 when it copies an ordinary content word, and at the floor (0.05-0.3) when the only thing it can copy is a newline, a period or a frequent function word.
